1479-3875-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3875-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4215-6495-6730.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4215-6495-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat from step 2

When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.

Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Reprobation and Capsize to your hand.

Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scrivener
When the Scrivener token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it

When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.

64-1987-2187-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Warden of the Eye.
When Possessed Skaab and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-2187-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

24-314-5644.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Judith triggers, giving Wheel of Misfortune deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to the highest number chosen to each player that chose it, causing those players to lose the game due to having 0 or less life.
If you chose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to you and causes you to gain that much life.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose lfie equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.

87-1211-1371-1771-2302.notablePrerequisites: Any color chosen with Painter's Servant.
87-1211-1371-1771-2302.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Mana Severance.
Resolve each opponent's Mana Severance, exiling all lands from their libraries.
Resolve your Mana Severance, choosing not to exile any lands from your library.
The next time you draw a card, Sphinx's Tutelage triggers, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Because Painter's Servant will force the cards to share a color, and they will not be lands due to the opponent having no lands in their library, Sphinx's Tutelage will continue to repeat the process until the opponent's library is empty.

988-1211-1371-1771-4078.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Mana Severance.
Resolve each opponent's Mana Severance, searching for and exiling all land cards from their libraries.
Resolve your Mana Severance, choosing not to exile any land cards from your library.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and three life, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield as a black Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
That creature enters the battlefield, triggering Umbris.
Resolve the Umbris trigger, revealing no lands from an opponent library, exiling their library.
Repeat from step 5 for each opponent.

Resolve The Cauldron of Eternity trigger first, putting the creature on the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature to the battlefield.
Repeat.

969-1991-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that can attack this turn.
Tana does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-1991-3259.description:
Deal combat damage with Tana and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Tana and Breath of Fury triggers.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens equal to the damage Tana dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
